summary: Take your organization to new heights with this Result-Based Management (RBM) Training. Learn proven strategies to deliver results and maximize efficiency
lede: Results-based management (RBM) connects project activities to measurable outputs, outcomes, and impact. For monitoring and evaluation professionals and program managers, it provides a structured way to plan projects, track progress, and assess results. This course covers building a Theory of Change and Logical Framework, setting SMART indicators and baselines, and organizing data collection and reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for designing, monitoring, and evaluating projects across public, private, and non-profit sectors.
modules: RBM Foundations and The Results Chain
prerequisites: Working knowledge of general project management or program administration is recommended. No advanced statistical or coding experience is required. Participants should bring a laptop to participate in the digital dashboard and framework drafting exercises.
